title: syringa reticulata var. amurensis
intro: Syringa reticulata var. amurensis, commonly known as Amur lilac, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the Oleaceae family. The Amur lilac is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, cough, and respiratory issues, making it beneficial for the health. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which aid in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Syringa reticulata var. amurensis include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
